encoding.tagline: Encoders and decoders for everyday formats
encoding.intro: Base64, URL, JWT, hex, binary, Unicode escape, HTML entities. Paste in, read out, done. All processing happens in your browser — input never leaves your machine.

formatters.tagline: Pretty-print and minify in one click
formatters.intro: JSON, SQL, XML, YAML, HTML, CSS, JavaScript. Each formatter shows a side-by-side preview and respects your indentation preferences.

generators.intro: UUIDs, secure passwords, hashes, mock data, QR codes, Lorem Ipsum. Tuned for speed and shipping defaults that match real-world usage.

converters.intro: JSON ↔ YAML ↔ TOML, CSV ↔ JSON, Markdown ↔ HTML, cURL → fetch/axios/Python, image format conversions. Sensible options surfaced; long-tail flags tucked away.

text-regex.tagline: Find, match, transform — strings made simple
text-regex.intro: Regex tester with live capture groups, text case converter, slugify, diff checker. Click-to-explain the regex so you understand what you wrote, not just that it ran.

time-date.tagline: Time zones, timestamps, and cron without guesswork
time-date.intro: Unix timestamp converter, cron expression parser with next-runs, time zone converter for distributed teams. Built for the 'wait, is that UTC?' moments.

web3.intro: Wallet address checker (ENS, format, checksum), ETH ↔ Wei converter. Lightweight, no wallet connection required.

marketing.intro: Lightweight utilities for SEO and campaign planning. Growing list.

ecommerce-vn.intro: Specialty tools for the Vietnamese e-commerce ecosystem.

finance.intro: Mortgage, loan, tip, percentage, compound interest — built so you can answer 'how much?' in seconds. No signup, no ads on calc pages, results stay local. For estimation only — verify with a licensed professional for high-stakes decisions.

health.intro: BMI, BMR, calorie targets, body composition — formulas from peer-reviewed research presented with metric + imperial side by side. For estimation only; consult a clinician for medical decisions.

lifestyle.tagline: Everyday tools that save you a search
lifestyle.intro: Age, GPA, sleep cycle, unit converter, percentage, word count, reading time — the small things you reach for daily, in one place, fast.

design.tagline: Color tools for designers and dev-adjacent folk
design.intro: HEX ↔ RGB ↔ HSL converter, WCAG contrast checker, palette generators — built for both pixel-pushers and content folks who care about accessibility.
